csv_project_name: AE for Facilities & Parks Maintenance Shop Redevelopment
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Renton is seeking Statements of Qualifications SOQs from qualified Architectural and Engineering A&E firms to provide professional design and construction support services for a city-wide Facilities Master Planning and Parks Shop Redevelopment Project. The work will support facilities located at 1100 Bronson Way North and a newly acquired site at 2940 E Valley Rd, and will integrate long-term operational, planning, and construction needs across the City s maintenance functions. The selected Consultant will provide comprehensive professional services that may include project management and coordination, site evaluation and existing conditions assessment, demolition planning and support services, temporary facility planning, design and perrnaitting support to maintain ongoing operations during construction, architectural and engtneering design services, preparation of design and construction bid documents, construction administration, construction management, and coordination with City staff, stakeholders, and the public as required.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering

short_description: Design and construction support for maintenance facilities master planning and redevelopment in Renton.

project_scope: City-wide facilities master planning and redevelopment for maintenance functions, covering existing facilities at 1100 Bronson Way North and a newly acquired site at 2940 E Valley Rd. services: Architectural and engineering design services; project management and coordination; site evaluation; existing conditions assessment; demolition planning support; temporary facility planning; permitting support; preparation of design and construction bid documents; construction administration; construction management; coordination with city staff, stakeholders, and the public. Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, programming, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, planning/master planning, redevelopment planning, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a general building and maintenance shop redevelopment project, not a bridge, long-span roof, stadium, or special structure.
- Strong focus on architecture, facilities planning, and multidisciplinary building services rather than structural innovation.
- Includes planning and design services, which gives some strategic relevance.
- However, maintenance/administrative-type facilities are generally low priority for sbp.
- No indication of unusual spans, lightweight structures, sustainability innovation, or architecturally demanding structural scope.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available cost-related context: city-wide facilities master planning and parks maintenance shop redevelopment at two sites, including demolition planning, temporary facilities, permitting, design, bid documents, and construction support. A realistic estimate is not possible from the provided information alone.
fee_explanation: No design fee or consultant budget is stated in the source. The notice is for qualifications-based A&E services covering planning, design, and construction support, but there is insufficient information to derive a reliable sbp fee estimate.
references_qualifications: Qualified architectural and engineering firms are requested to submit Statements of Qualifications. No specific minimum reference projects, fee zones, or quantified qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
